passages.text:
Re: USAID-YouTube Call to Discuss Creator List
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Meredith Kresman Monday, October 3, 2022 at 1:57:09 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Amy Malessa
Ccl [opaque block]
uaie ors atnan teman, e ealina gar er 2acrn kalan, ingeuaid or ernain long.
[contact omitted] Shadrach Ludeman, [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
Hi Amy,
I hope you had a great weekend!
Here's a site about how YouTube works for creators.
Generally the trainings are customized for the audience so we don't have an off the shelf example to
share.
Hope this helps and more to come!
On Fri, Sep 30, 2022 at 4:42 PM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sure thing! I'Il look at calendars. Let us know if there's anything we can do to help with those internal conversations.
Can you send us examples of the in-house trainings that you offer? That will help us tailor the approach on our side
Best,
Amy
Amy Noreuil Malessa
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team
US Agency for International Development
[opaque block] | [contact omitted]
[opaque block]
On Fri, Sep 30, 2022 at 4:13 PM Meredith Kresman - [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi everyone,
Happy Friday!
Would it be possible to push out Monday's call by a week or so?
We need to have a few more internal conversations.
Apologies for the delay!
On Fri, Sep 2, 2022 at 12:05 PM Josh Blumenfeld - [opaque block] [contact omitted]>wrote:
On Fri, Sep 2, 2022 at 12:04 PM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Great, thank you for confirming! We will share the spreadsheet with her.
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team
US Agency for International Development
[opaque block] | [contact omitted]
On Fri, Sep 2, 2022 at 12:02 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Yes she's on our europe team! Thank you for flagging though.

On Fri, Sep 2, 2022 at 11:52 AM Amy Malessa < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Meredith,
Marijn [contact omitted]) is requesting access to our spreadsheet. Is this
someone you know? Looking torward to our call on Tuesday at 9am Eastern.
Thank you!
Amy
Amy Noreuil Malessa
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team
US Agency for International Development
[contact omitted]
On Wed, Aug 24, 2022 at 1:03 PM Meredith Kresman < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks Amy! Confirming receipt and we will circle back with any questions.
On Wed, Aug 24, 2022 at 11:24 AM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh and Meredith,
Thanks again for our call earlier this month! Our programs in Ukraine and Moldova compiled a list of
You Tube creators who we think could benefit from training and support. It's a diverse group, so we are
excited to hear what you think is possible.
We look forward to discussing options and next steps on Tuesday, September 6th at 9am Eastern. I'm
happy to move around our invite, if you need to adjust the date/time. In the meantime, feel welcome to
ping us with questions, ideas, etc.!
Best,
Amy
Amy Noreuil Malessa
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team
US Agency for International Development
